description: Return the full relationship map your avatar carries toward other Sims currently known to the local VM — the VMAvatar.MeToObject table projected into a simple list. Each entry includes with_persist_id, with_name, friendly (long-term feeling, range -100..100), and daily (today's interactions, range -100..100). Prerequisite: you are joined to a lot. Effect: none — local-VM read, no outbound PDU. Cost: O(known relationships) under VM lock; tiny. Relationships with Sims who are not currently in your VM (not on the same lot, or their entity not yet resolved) are omitted — you only see rels for Sims whose ObjectID is live. For persistent cross-session relationship data consult DataService queries (future verb). Use this for mid-turn social decisions: 'do I like this Sim enough to accept their dance request?'
call_signatures: cf $CF query-relationships                                                           # no args; full MeToObject rel vector dump
common_mistakes: These are LOCAL VM reads — they reflect whatever your client-side replica VM shows, which may lag the authoritative state by 1-2 ticks.
Only Sims whose ObjectID is live in your current lot VM appear here — cross-lot relationships are not surfaced until the DataService feed is wired (freesoexperiment-1a9).
perception_hints: These ops return the same shape as the corresponding perception slice; use for fresh mid-turn snapshots
Perception already pushes this data at FSO_PERCEPTION_HZ — only call when you need data newer than the last tick
